'''Wen Lu-Dasz''' was a rich and eccentric [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Mission" /> By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Irreplaceable Parts" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> he needed replacement parts for [[Wen Lu-Dasz's yacht|his yacht]] that could not be purchased through normal channels.<ref name="Mission" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], an individual affiliated with one of the two warring governments had a companion of theirs make arrangements to acquire the parts for Lu-Dasz's [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]]. The companion was able to secure a deal, ensuring that the yacht would operate flawlessly for some [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="Mission" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Wen Lu-Dasz was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Irreplaceable Parts" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Mission" />
